raw.body:
## Status
**STEP 9 COMPLETE — 9/10. Original-game Daily Stackbreaker is LIVE on the public website with one server-recorded run/profile/UTC day, 365 original date-matched puzzles, server-verified leaderboard and profile-owned rewards. Step 10 final authenticated production QA remains OPEN.** Owner requested an implementation plan for ideas **#5 Daily Stackbreaker, #9 Mastery Titles and Cosmetics, #10 Advanced Magic Mechanics** on 2026-10-19.

## Verified architecture (baseline)
- Game Lab: `Squackle/deep-cuts-game-lab-`, owner lane **only `stackbreaker/**`**, branches `game/stackbreaker-*`. Main SHA observed in planning: `65d44cc3cb962871248fac175a88bd5751b91aab` (recheck latest before any edit).
- Website: `Squackle/deep-cuts-edh` main `6c19b8540154d12b035d06ae3ee443d2999dbace` (recheck); authenticated profiles and authoritative APIs/D1 owned **only** by website developer; requires separate owner authorization. Lab must NEVER claim authoritative account rewards or public scores.
- 250 Classic puzzles: 30 preserved / 220 generated, five galaxies, local save keys `dc-stackbreaker-progress-v3`, `dc-stackbreaker-last-level`. Limited rules engine `sb-mtg-training-0.3.0`, with single `targetId`, opponent auto-pass, synchronous effect switch. Advanced modes/copies/triggers/ward/replacements NOT fully implemented. Preserve existing Classic save/replay behavior and original scenario IDs.
- Source of truth for rules: Wizards' current [Comprehensive Rules](https://magic.wizards.com/en/rules) + [Gatherer Oracle](https://gatherer.wizards.com/). Planning reference: official rules effective **2026-09-25** ([text](https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020260925.txt)); verify newer rules again when coding, especially 115, 117, 601, 603, 608, 614–616, 700, 702, 707. Forge is optional unofficial independent cross-check, **not** inspected/run yet. Never copy its GPL code.

## Feature contract
**Daily (#5):** one shared puzzle per UTC date with visible reset clock (confirm timezone); 90+ curated and tested starting scenarios selected via date/versioned immutable manifest; identical scenario globally, no daily AI cron. Separate unlimited practice from one qualifying scored attempt each day, with anti-hint/undo rule explicitly decided. Guest/local attempts labeled **unverified**. Spoiler-free share card/text, optional archive, stable past daily versions. No revival of retired Daily Ritual leaderboards.

**Mastery (#9):** ~20–25 meaningful verified achievement types (e.g. First Response, Countermage, Clean Stack, Explorer, Fivefold Apprentice, Seven Dates, Stack Surgeon, Trigger Technician, Ward Specialist, Replacement Scholar). Deterministic semantic event ledger, no rewards from VFX clicks or locally forged claims. ~8–12 equip-able titles, five mana-colored profile frames and five optional spell FX themes, all cosmetic. In Lab local preview only; real My Profile equip/sync requires owner-approved website change, authenticated server validation and D1 schema review.

**Advanced rules (#10):** limited, authoritative two-player teaching engine (not a universal Commander simulator), eventually support modal spells, target changing, spell copies, triggered abilities, ward payment/countering, replacement/prevention interactions. Change version with legacy compatibility: candidate `sb-mtg-training-0.4.0` (proposal, not deployed). Copies are not casts; ward triggers rather than forbidding a legal target; replacements act before events rather than being ordinary stack triggers. Verify exact official interactions/cards when adding them. Target at least 30 fully validated new advanced puzzles with meaningful wrong lines.

## Ten implementation checkpoints — ONE per future owner-approved “next”
- [x] **1 — Design/contracts:** freeze daily date/reset/scoring, achievement IDs, event/replay schema, rules version, guest/profile boundaries and migrations; baseline all 250 Classic tests.
- [x] **2 — Daily in Game Lab:** 90+ curated reviewed dated entries; deterministic resolver, countdown, practice/scored UX, spoiler-free shares, local-only results. Tests for dates/timezones/DST/leap days/identical puzzles and successful/failed solves.
- [x] **3 — Mastery ledger in Game Lab:** semantic engine events and ~20–25 achievement criteria; idempotent unlock/progress; no duplicate awards/undo farming; no VFX-only achievements.
- [x] **4 — Cosmetic equip UI in Lab:** gallery for titles, mana frames and cosmetic spell styles, persisted locally only, accessible/reduced motion and mobile-safe. No gameplay modifiers.
- [x] **5 — Engine foundation:** richer typed stack entries, mode choices, multiple targets, serialization/priority and adapters for legacy targetId; deterministic replay version bump; all Classic puzzles preserved.
- [x] **6 — Copy/retarget:** correct copies and new target selection, mode persistence, cast-vs-copy distinction, controller legality, negative rule cases and advanced puzzles.
- [x] **7 — Trigger and ward engine:** stack triggers, correct order and priority, verified pay/not-pay ward, intervening state, source leaves/last-known information where necessary; positive/negative rule tests.
- [x] **8 — Replacement/prevention plus new puzzle pack:** affected-player choices, single-application replacements and prevention ordering, ≥30 advanced validated scenarios; verify official Oracle and rules; preserve Classic.
- [x] **9 — Website integration only with **separate explicit approval****: website developer builds authenticated daily attempt replay-verification APIs, account-owned achievements/cosmetics, safe additive D1 schema, idempotent keys, rate limiting, profile equip, guest transition policy. No Lab access to production identities/D1.
- [ ] **10 — Full QA/staged release:** all Classic/advanced rules replay, date rollover, guest vs authenticated proof, accessibility/mobile, Cloudflare previews/production exact SHAs, rollback; website promotion separately authorized and checked.

## Acceptance and protection rules
- No changing the existing 250 scenario IDs, progress or already-earned stars; tests for full campaign and altered rules version.
- One globally consistent daily manifest and no retroactive alteration; no cron needed to choose today’s puzzle; content replenishment strategy before 90 entries run out.
- Server (website lane only) must independently replay qualifying scored action logs under pinned rules/content version. Rate limit and reject cross-account access/duplicate claims; do not trust localStorage, client badge claims or screenshots for authoritative rewards.
- For every new advanced rule: official rule-number/card-Oracle evidence, relevant positive+negative case, deterministic replay and cross-version test; check Forge only when practical and report whether actually run.
- All new visuals/menus keyboard/touch/screen-reader friendly, including reduced-motion and colorblind alternatives.
- Separate feature branches/PRs and green unified Lab CI; preserve other game lanes. No public main-site deployment on this issue alone.
- Record full tested Lab SHA, QA, rollbacks and any owner approval at each checkpoint in this issue. Do not tick a box until implementation and tests actually passed.

## Tracking
Owner can ask to start **Step 1** after reviewing this plan. A future chat can read this issue, inspect latest two repos/main/open PRs, pick the first unchecked checkpoint, and update this log **without starting later stages**. An approval to implement in Game Lab **does not** approve production website, profile schema or score writes.

Potential source placement (proposed, not yet committed): `stackbreaker/data/daily-manifest.json`, `data/achievements.json`, `data/advanced-scenarios.json`, `src/daily.js`, `src/mastery.js`, `src/rules-events.js`, `src/rules-advanced.js`, `src/verify-replay.js`, tests, and standalone daily/mastery views. Only website developer may add profile/verified-score APIs or D1 migrations after approval.
### Completed Step 1 release — 2026-10-19
- [PR #98](https://github.com/Squackle/deep-cuts-game-lab-/pull/98) merged to Game Lab main commit `c9e2ecae97dde33067bd00fbdcec8c40b8876c1e`.
- Cloudflare Game Lab production deployment `93554fd5-2c5e-4718-a245-42d106b41e3e`: **deploy success**; trigger SHA matches merge SHA exactly.
- Unified Lab GitHub CI **545 tests passed, 0 failed** on final branch head `f9b0b1a4ce4a8aed6528ad60ba36531514473115`; release-coordination **success**. New tests explicitly validate all **250 unchanged Classic scenarios** and the planning contract invariants.
- [Step 1 spec](https://github.com/Squackle/deep-cuts-game-lab-/blob/main/stackbreaker/planning/STEP-1-ARCHITECTURE.md), [versioned contract mock](https://github.com/Squackle/deep-cuts-game-lab-/blob/main/stackbreaker/planning/daily-mastery-advanced-contracts-v1.json), 8 new contract tests; all are non-runtime.
- Frozen defaults: shared UTC midnight reset, one score-eligible attempt *start* per account/day, no hints or undo during scored attempts, accepted state-changing action counts, minimum 90 reviewed daily candidates, local guest marked unverified, 24 idempotent achievement definitions and future authenticated/replay/D1 boundaries. Advanced `sb-mtg-training-0.4.0` remains **only a proposal**.
- Existing gameplay, 250 puzzle IDs, progress/stars, Magic rules, public Deep Cuts EDH site, authenticated profiles, D1 and other game lanes untouched. No website promotion was authorized.
- **Next: Step 2 (Daily Stackbreaker Game Lab prototype) only if owner says “next”.**

### Completed Step 2 release — 2026-10-19
- **[PR #101](https://github.com/Squackle/deep-cuts-game-lab-/pull/101)** merged as Game Lab production commit `54d38c226f4aa7d1f785d8e52153b972535fabd0`. Cloudflare production deployment `19dd960f-f435-4f24-962a-20ec5247a4a4` returned `deploy:success`; **exact SHA match verified**.
- Final branch head `01ae67a1ccc677c9a13aeb812b783e6457b15c7d`: GitHub Unified Game Lab checks **563/563 tests passed, 0 failed**, Release coordination **success**.
- **Actual Cloudflare Browser Rendering** on successful preview `f41301d5.deep-cuts-game-lab.pages.dev`: 390px mobile verified UTC day, practice hint/restart enabled, scored hints/undo/restart disabled, separate local data and no horizontal overflow. 1280px desktop verified actual priority pass writes 1 accepted action, date/status share text is spoiler-free LOCAL/UNVERIFIED, desktop doc width=viewport. No claimed phone screenshot pixel QA beyond interactive DOM check.
- **Live Daily:** https://deep-cuts-game-lab.pages.dev/stackbreaker/daily/ ; Classic standard https://deep-cuts-game-lab.pages.dev/stackbreaker/ unaffected. 365 explicit UTC date bindings through 2027-10-18 using 90 preselected scenario IDs. New daily localStorage key `dc-stackbreaker-daily-local-v1`, no authenticated profile/D1 changes and no legacy stars or progress writes from Daily mode.
- **Editorial launch gate remains open:** 30 already approved core + 60 existing generated scenarios are engine-validated but **the 60 require human editorial review** before any public competitive/verified launch. Guest local storage can be cleared/tampered with; one scored start is one/device/date and strictly **LOCAL / UNVERIFIED**. Date manifest needs replenishment ahead of expiry. A future website-only authenticated scorer requires separate owner approval (Step 9).
- **Step 2 complete on Game Lab prototype only. Step 3 — mastery ledger — not started.** Wait for owner "next." Canonical [feature handoff](https://github.com/Squackle/deep-cuts-game-lab-/blob/main/stackbreaker/planning/STEP-2-DAILY-HANDOFF.md) includes source/test details but predates final merge; THIS ISSUE's completed-release note supersedes its pending status.

### Completed Step 3 release — 2026-10-19
- **[PR #107](https://github.com/Squackle/deep-cuts-game-lab-/pull/107)** merged to Game Lab main SHA `a8f2b4f30f9b7fe75a66f261b1fd4bbf058af0d4`; **Cloudflare Game Lab production** deployment `fd59c1e3-e95f-440b-a632-22084ed05ac3`: **deploy:success** and exact SHA match.

- **Actual Cloudflare browser QA** on SHA-matched preview `042e5b0c-c39d-4da6-8ebc-6e278f1c3bfd`: 390px mobile played actual Selfless Spirit and 3 priority passes for a genuine victory, unlocking *First Response* and *Perfect Window*; exactly one case (`sb-01@1`) stored under `dc-stackbreaker-mastery-local-v1`, 9 future achievements locked, 24 listed, Classic stars unaffected and no horizontal overflow. 1280px desktop solved same case twice after reset: one distinct win persisted, 2 unlocks (no duplication), full-width layout no overflow.
- All **24** contracted achievements are listed: **15 available to earn locally** from genuine engine-confirmed Classic victories; **6 advanced-rule milestones** and **3 server-verified Daily milestones** remain locked. Counterspells, protection, lifegain, exiling and other semantics are derived from actual before/after engine state, never CSS/VFX.

raw.title: P1.1 next: attest worker lifecycle and design representative multi-agent A/B benchmarks
raw.body:
## Contexte
P1.1 V3 interactive TUI : 4/4 PASS pour la correction `total.py`, mais écarts tokens contradictoires entre les deux paires. PR #14 toujours OPEN. Historique détaillé `docs/P1_1_V3_RESULTS_2026-10-29.md`.

PR #60 ajoute un agrégateur **offline** pour rapports TUI et compteurs tirés d'une capture expurgée, sans appel IA, mais ne résout pas l'attestation indépendante des workers et de la politique effective.

## Workstream A — Instrumentation native/attestation (avant prochains modèles)
- [ ] Sur le CLI **épinglé 0.165.0**, identifier les surfaces de télémétrie structurée *supportées* (app-server/TUI/événements documentés), sans lire, exporter ou copier les sessions privées, secrets, IDs bruts ou journaux auth.
- [ ] Définir un schéma allowlist : dispatch demandé/observé, started/completed, nombre de workers, error-category, execution gate, provenance de la preuve, token input/output/cache avec sémantique déclarée, operator touch count, phase elapsed. Aucun prompt, chemin privé, contenu de commande ou session ID.
- [ ] Si aucune surface native ne fournit ces champs, les marquer `not_observed` plutôt que fabriquer une preuve. La déclaration `worker_delegation_independently_verified=false` et `policy_effectiveness=not_runtime_attested` doit demeurer tant que non prouvée.
- [ ] Tests synthétiques sans modèle : missing/duplicate/out-of-order events, redaction, timestamp handling, crash/blocked/failure, tampered/mixed contract, Windows escaping, no files written outside disposable outputs.
- [ ] Ne pas introduire de rétrocompatibilité silencieuse avec V2/V3 : nouveau schéma et contrat expérimental au besoin.

## Workstream B — Benchmark représentatif
- [ ] Établir au moins 3 **classes de tâches** (ex. modification mécanique, bug multi-fichier avec tests, diagnostic d'incident/auto-correction), avec fixtures isolées déterministes et critères d'acceptation indépendants.
- [ ] Appariement baseline/candidate avec alternance d'ordre, prompts identiques et pas de réutilisation d'outputs ; enregistrer versions, AGENTS fingerprints, modèle/effort, sandbox, interactions manuelles.
- [ ] Critères de non-régression sur tests, Git diff, délégation, autorisations et capacités d'autocorrection ; calcul descriptif avec dispersion, sans transformer deux paires en preuve statistique ou assimiler tokens et quota.
- [ ] Préflight et plan par défaut **sans modèle**, autorisation explicite séparée pour toute campagne payante ; stop au premier échec et préservation immuable des FAIL.

## Interdits
Aucun nouvel appel Codex, fusion de #14, changement global Codex 0.164.0, copie de `auth.json`, élévation UAC, désactivation MXC, réparation rétroactive d'un échec V2 ou suppression de preuves tant que cette issue n'a pas un plan de validation approuvé.

Dépendances : #34, #14, #59 (rapport V3), #60 (agrégateur hors modèle).

raw.body:
## Start here — owner operating guide (November 9, 2026)

**[Open the live status and dependency map](https://github.com/killbill2792/aicafe/issues/411#issuecomment-6752417190)** · **[Read the permanent product blueprint and original decision links](https://github.com/killbill2792/aicafe/blob/main/docs/plans/owner-living-blueprint.md)** · [See the proven blueprint change, PR #416](https://github.com/killbill2792/aicafe/pull/416).

**Everyday use:** Open the status/map for pending decisions, each PR's next actor and verification; open the linked original PR before approving its exact scope. For a new idea/fix, tell your connected ChatGPT conversation **“Read the AI CAFE blueprint and current GitHub PRs; brainstorm and show me the changed architecture and PR tasks before coding.”** When satisfied, say **“Record my exact approval in GitHub on the related issue/PR, and update the existing blueprint and authorized task queue as needed.”** Check that the GitHub write succeeded; a chat message by itself does **not** become an authenticated approval. The existing dispatcher then reconciles GitHub and continues eligible tasks through Muse/ChatGPT/Claude. To request a read-only status update, comment `refresh status` here and reload this page when the trusted GitHub workflow has finished.

**What works now:** PR #416 merged the read-only living blueprint and GitHub-derived dependency map into the *existing* Actions-owned dashboard comment; dispatcher reconciliation is automatic but GitHub's five-minute schedule is best-effort. **What is not yet automatic:** writing every future chat decision into GitHub, regenerating prose decisions without a reviewed GitHub change, push/live-refreshing this already-open browser tab, or hosting an authenticated standalone GitHub Pages website. Those are **future scoped proposals**, not permissions to create a second dispatcher, expose private data, or bypass owner/CI/Codex gates. Preserve this issue as the single place to design the trusted chat-to-GitHub write-through and owner-view enhancements if requested.

---

## Live owner dashboard

[**Open the current AI CAFE dispatcher status**](https://github.com/killbill2792/aicafe/issues/411#issuecomment-6752417190). This single GitHub Actions-owned comment updates in place with verified reconciliation results. Reply **refresh status** to this issue to request a read-only refresh; answer scoped approvals on the exact linked PR, not in the dashboard comment.

---

## Owner request — one understandable control center for the EXISTING dispatcher and Muse
The AI CAFE owner cannot currently see where a task is stuck, where approval was requested, whether Muse actually delivered a GitHub continuation, or why a clean Codex review did not cause a draft to merge. The owner wants to **read and speak in normal English** to the dispatcher and Muse from one owner-friendly place, without editing JSON or hunting for invisible PR-body markers.

This is a **tracking/design request, not authorization to code, expand task paths, deploy, approve existing questions, or override merge/production gates**. Obtain an exact, owner-approved implementation scope and reuse the current dispatcher/queue/ledger/courier paths under AGENTS.md. No second task queue, agent, cron, secret store, or parallel approval authority.

### Concrete observed failures (November 9, 2026)
- #404 (POS0e) is an open draft, has red baseline and two P1 Codex findings. Its actionable owner scope question appears in [issue comment #6741376971](https://github.com/killbill2792/aicafe/pull/404#issuecomment-6741376971) with the `needs-owner-decision` label, but no matching live `aicafe-owner-question` marker in PR body; the private ledger's pending owner-alert list omitted this question. An owner should never have to inspect an HTML comment or know a parser rule to see an approval.
- #405, #406 and #407 have owner questions in PR bodies, but private owner notices were still `planned` and had **no verified Muse owner-notice delivery** at the inspection. Show this distinctly from "delivered" or "approved."
- Private ledger showed three `repair_ci` courier actions for POS0b/c/d in `planned`, with no submitted receipt. Do not claim that Muse failed or that a prompt was delivered without checking its authenticated receipt.
- #406/#407 have clean Codex current-head evidence in their PR conversation, yet the full baselines failed; #407 acceptance execution was skipped. All #405–407 are stacked on unmerged #404. Correctly explain why drafts cannot auto-ready/merge and distinguish gate status from stale ledger Codex summary.
- Dispatcher auto-ready/merge work landed in #410, but current full-proof barriers and actual runtime settings/receipts need operator visibility. Do not equate code merged with a verified live automation cycle.

### Required one owner-facing dashboard
1. **Today / Needs me / Tasks / Dispatcher history / Muse deliveries** in one clear private, authenticated view. Plain language first, with exact source links and last-refreshed timestamp. Owner must see what happened while offline, what's currently executing, what's queued, what is held, and next responsible party.
2. For each task show: task name and PR; coding scope approval (independent of production permission); coder; dependency/stack base; draft/ready/merged; CI broken job and execution link; exact-head Codex clean/findings; acceptance artifact status; integrated_proven; last commit/activity; owner question and direct actionable link; dispatcher proposed/sent action; Muse assigned/planned/submitted/receipt/uncertain and next eligibility/retry.
3. **Owner decisions must never disappear:** reconcile every open `needs-owner-decision` label, owner question in PR body AND trusted owner question in PR conversation/comments. Surface a visible full question with source URL, options, what permission would change, affected files/PR, and whether already answered. Do not treat an HTML comment as user-facing notice; do not infer approval from a courier receipt, clean Codex, PR merge, or chat transcript.
4. **Human-readable chronological history:** task/PR status transitions; dispatcher reconciliations; approval requests and recorded decisions; queued/rescheduled/cancelled actions; Muse delivery receipt; verified code activity; tests/reviews; why each merge gate passed/failed. Preserve source GitHub IDs, SHAs, workflow URLs and timestamps; distinguish `observed`, `inferred`, `not verified`, and `not delivered`.
5. **Talk to dispatcher/Muse in normal English:** the owner can ask "What is blocked?", "Show my pending approvals", "Why not merged?", "Tell Muse to continue the existing chat", "Hold task X", and "Approve precisely this scope". Translate only authorized actions into the existing trusted GitHub owner-question/queue path with a preview/exact effect and immutable audit receipt; require explicit owner confirmation for approval/scope/production changes. Never rely on private ChatGPT transcript as implicit GitHub approval. Muse remains a courier, not a coding/decision agent.
6. **No false green:** distinguish Codex review completed/clean at current SHA from all CI jobs, unresolved review threads, acceptance evidence job+artifact, stacked predecessor merged-main integration, owner decision and production gates. Display actionable failed checks and next owner (coder vs dispatcher vs Muse vs human).
7. **Privacy/security:** preserve private ledger/prompts, chat URLs, user identifiers, auth tokens and HMAC signals in the existing private boundary. Do not leak them to public issue/PR/workflow logs, and do not expose a privileged action endpoint without authenticated owner checks.
8. **Proof:** red-to-green tests for missing #404 comment question, hidden-marker visibility, planned-not-delivered Muse receipt, stale Codex summary despite current-head clean, red CI blocking auto-merge, correct post-receipt follow-up, duplicate suppression, owner-approved instruction routing, safe read-only history, and zero bypass of existing approval/merge rules. Demonstrate a complete owner journey from PR owner question -> dashboard notice -> authenticated owner decision -> dispatcher correction -> Muse verified delivery -> coder activity/CI -> proof-gated ready/merge (using disposable/test PRs, no production action).

### Required first step
Provide a small architecture/file-ownership and security plan on this issue for owner approval, identifying which **existing** dispatcher/ledger/owner-event code will be extended and where the authenticated owner view should live. Do not start a second workflow. Do not interrupt current POS0 PR repair or alter their signed scopes merely to make a UI look green.

**Owner-visible success criterion:** The owner opens one page, immediately knows whether GitHub, Muse, a coder, failing tests, an unresolved comment, or the owner is the next actor, and can give authorized instructions in normal English with tracked receipt and no hidden requests.

raw.body:
<!-- MYGAME_LEAD_BOARD_LINK -->
**Current coordination:** [MyGame Codex · lead task board](https://github.com/rempemat-eng/appify/issues/149#issuecomment-6475643125) (edited in place).

Matt asked this chat to coordinate the four new Codex chats with Claude through GitHub.

This is the live registration and handoff thread. The durable handoff is in [draft PR #150](https://github.com/rempemat-eng/appify/pull/150), with an additive AGENTS.md pointer once Claude merges it. AGENTS.md and docs/vision/coherence-plan.md remain the authority for scope and ownership. Existing explicit per-chat assignments and start conditions are preserved. No game rules or mechanics are approved here.

## Four chat assignments

The current continuation records clarify the groupings below. These are assigned scopes, not proof that a worker has acknowledged this hub or is running.

| Chat / assigned scope | Order and branches | Start / integration gates | Acknowledged here |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| NapAttack Codex · C29 C30 world canvas | C29 on `codex/world-saves`, then C30 on `codex/ways-route-graph` | Both #123 and #126 changes must be on main before implementation. C30 also consumes #118's ways contract. | Not yet |
| NapAttack Codex · C32 C31 gates and map | C32 on `codex/ci-gates`, then C31 on `codex/world-map-canvas` | Both #142 and #145 changes must be on main before either implementation. C31 additionally needs the canvas and C29 save contracts. | Not yet |
| C33 economy simulation | One simulation-only PR; reuse an existing branch if present | Model current rules and label L2/G10 as scenarios. #143 remains a proposal, not production rules. | Not yet |
| C34 native pixels | One isolated spike PR; reuse an existing branch if present | Agree platform-adapter ownership with Claude A, consume the canvas contract, keep the flag off; memory/frame-time results require an actual native dev build. | Not yet |

C29/C30 and C32/C31 must honour their explicit no-implementation-before-prerequisites instructions. While blocked, use read-only review; do not write speculative production adapters or take another chat's tasks.

## Register an existing chat

Post one comment with `ACK | task=Cn (and next task) | chat=<existing title> | branch=<existing task branch> | PR=<link/status> | files=<owned paths> | based-on=<main SHA> | state=<state> | needs=<dependency>`.

Read the latest comments, main, queue/Feedback and open PRs before editing. Existing claims win. Do not steal a task after an elapsed timer or push to another worker's branch. If duplicate claims appear, stop overlapping writes and resolve them here with Claude A.

## File boundaries and known blockers

- C29 alone owns save-schema/serialization changes and shared historical save fixtures. C31 supplies its discovery payload and migration requirements to C29. Claude A retains `lib/world-layouts.ts`, `lib/world-save.ts`, generated canvas files, world traversal and renderer files.
- C30 owns new pure gating/tests, not the generated graph or visual/traversal implementation. In #126, the current graph is per-region, and direct window walking searches can bypass graph fallback. Test all search paths, future connectors/transport edges, cached routes and cancellation; graph-edge removal alone is insufficient.
- C32 owns CI wiring and summaries. The new whole-world command is `check:world-audit`; preserve existing `check:world` save checks. #142's redraw/measurement/kit-marker prerequisites still apply. Hash-based preview caches must not skip compliance checks.
- Coordinate additive `package.json` edits before writing; keep dependency changes and lockfiles under one owner at a time. C34 adds packages only through `npx expo install`.
- Canvas draft origins are placeholders. Migrate against versioned historical transforms, never whatever origin the current generator produces.
- #126 also has an unresolved retained-tile-budget review comment. Do not call skipped checks passes or enable WORLD_CANVAS on the strength of source tests.
- C33 cannot change live payouts, costs, save data or balances. Do not fold the separate #146 home-base proposal into C33 without a new instruction.
- C34 cannot edit Claude's components or claim desktop results as native/device evidence. A report-only spike remains incomplete if the native measurement requirement is not met.

## Persistent automatic assignment checks

On 20 October, Matt explicitly requested that ALL FOUR slots activate after receiving tasks from this coordinator or Claude. Four persistent hourly continuations are now enabled and their saved prompts/schedules have been read back:

| Slot | Initial work | Automatic check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `world-canvas` | C29 → C30 | Hourly; rechecks #123/#126 on main and C30's additional contracts before implementation |
| `ci-map` | C32 → C31 | Hourly; rechecks #142/#145 and the current marker/canvas/save requirements |
| `economy` | C33 | Hourly; preserves the existing PR #151 worker and looks for addressed follow-ups |
| `native-pixels` | C34 | Hourly; preserves codex/native-pixels and consumes Claude A's agreed pixel-image boundary |

The earlier C29/C30 merge-only watcher is paused after its hourly replacement was confirmed enabled. There are four active NapAttack assignment continuations, not an extra competing merge watcher.

The checks remain enabled after the initial tasks finish. They must not pause merely because they have no work, recreate completed tasks, start arbitrary generic queue work, or create restart chains. They report only meaningful changes. Explicit PAUSED/CANCELLED/REASSIGNED instructions are honoured.

### Assign a future task

Claude A or the coordinator can post an explicit assignment here, or in the current queue/Feedback, with:

`ASSIGN | slot=world-canvas/ci-map/economy/native-pixels | task=<stable task ID and revision> | scope=<approved work> | prerequisites=<real gates> | branch=<own isolated branch> | files=<agreed ownership>`

Choose one actual slot value, not the whole list. Each checker reads the issue AND comments, the latest main/AGENTS/coordination/vision files and its task PR. It records the assignment ID and actual branch/head, so later checks know what was acknowledged, completed, released, paused or reassigned. New assignments remain within Matt's approved project scope and lane boundaries.

An active owner's branch is not taken over because it looks quiet or a lease expires. If ownership is unconfirmed, the checker performs read-only review and requests a handoff once. Shared saves/manifests remain single-writer work.

Claude A has now acknowledged this hub and supplied integration decisions in his comment; workers must read those decisions rather than treat them as unanswered.

These are saved-task continuations, not remote control of arbitrary existing chat windows. The enabled settings have been verified; no real future hourly run or cross-chat delivery is claimed yet. Scheduling is not a guarantee of an exact execution time.

## Handoff and review

Each task gets its own draft PR, titled `[Cn taken] ...`. Keep it draft through iteration. Run `npm run verify` and `npm run check:art-repro` on the exact final source, mark ready once, then inspect matching CI. Only after matching CI passes use `[Cn complete]`. Do not repeatedly merge main just to refresh checks; follow current AGENTS.md's CI policy. Report failures/blocked dependencies accurately.

Each handoff records branch/head/base, files, what changed, tests/results, missing coverage and the precise request for the receiving chat or Claude. Feedback belongs on the existing task PR plus a short status here; Codex does not edit docs/vision to communicate unless Matt has explicitly authorised that narrow edit for the specific chat. The coordinator will use this issue and a docs/codex PR without extending that exception.

Claude A retains integration/merge responsibility under Matt's existing plan. Codex never pushes main, merges or enables auto-merge. Quiet activity is not a completion signal.

Claude A has acknowledged this hub. External Codex worker acknowledgements are tracked in the comments; do not infer receipt from a schedule setting. The coordinator cannot directly send into the four chat windows from this session. This is an asynchronous GitHub channel, not continuous supervision.

Ran: latest-main/AGENTS/queue/Feedback and PR/branch review; current continuation-assignment lookup; read-only canvas/ways/audit dependency review.
Did not test: full verify/art regeneration, browser gameplay, native builds/devices or worker implementations. No game source changed.
